app "Workouts" dumbbell ink
table lift exercise text, kg num 0.. = 0 unit "kg", sets num 1..20 = 3, reps num 1..100
state ex text = last(lift.exercise)
state adding bool = no
state d new lift keep
let vol = sum(lift week, it.kg * it.sets * it.reps)
let before = sum(lift prev week where weekday(at) <= weekday(today), it.kg * it.sets * it.reps)
let trained = count(days week, count(lift on it) > 0)
let hi = max(lift.kg last 35 days where exercise = ex)
let lo = min(lift last 35 days where exercise = ex)
row bar
  button if(adding, "Close", "Log exercise") fill if(adding, soft, accent) tap set adding = not adding
if adding
  stack card gap 3
    field d
    "Use 0 kg for bodyweight moves like push-ups." faint
    button "Save set" fill accent tap save d then set adding = no
row gap 1
  each days week
    stack grow gap 1 align center
      dayname(it) tiny color if(it = today, ink, muted)
      box height 36 radius 8 fill if(count(lift on it) > 0, accent, soft)
        it if(count(lift on it) > 0, ", trained", "rest") opacity 0
stack gap 1
  if count(lift today) > 0
    plural(count(lift today), "exercise") "today," sum(lift today, it.sets) "sets" head
  else
    scroll gap 1
      each lift last 60 days by exercise
        button it.key fill if(ex = it.key, ink, surface) tap set ex = it.key
    if count(lift last 35 days where exercise = ex) < 2
      "Log" ex "twice to see a line." color muted
    else
      row gap 3
        stack gap 0
          hi "kg" head
          "best set, 5 weeks" faint
        stack gap 0
          count(lift last 35 days where exercise = ex) "times" head
          "logged" faint
      plot 0..35, lo..hi axes gridlines
        poly stroke accent thick 2
          each lift last 35 days where exercise = ex sort at
            pt 35 - (now - it.at) / 1d, it.kg
        circle 35 - (now - last(lift.at where exercise = ex)) / 1d, last(lift.kg where exercise = ex), 1 fill accent
        tick 1, today - 34
        tick 34, "Today"
      "Latest:" last(lift.kg where exercise = ex) "kg for" last(lift.reps where exercise = ex) "reps. Weights in kg." faint
"Recent" head
each lift last 14 days by day as g empty "Nothing logged in the last two weeks."
  g.key bold faint
  each g as r
    row card tap edit r swipe remove r
      r.exercise grow bold
      r.sets "x" r.reps color muted
      r.kg "kg"

state m date = today
state cat text = ""
state adding bool = no

  button "<" tap set m = addmonths(m, -1)

  if(left >= 0, "Left to spend", "Over budget by") color muted

    abs(left) big color if(left >= 0, ink, bad)
    "of" budget color muted tap edit budget
  draw 100, 2
    rect 0, 0, 100, 2 fill soft radius 1
    rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(spent / budget, 0, 1), 2 fill if(spent > budget, bad, accent) radius 2
    rect 100 * day / monthdays(m), 0, 0.6, 4 fill ink
  row
    spent "spent" faint grow
    "day" day "of" monthdays(m) faint
  if now_month and left > 0
    stack fill soft pad 2 radius 10
      round(left / (monthdays(m) - day + 1)) "a day keeps you on budget for the rest of the month."
  if now_month
    button if(adding, "Close", "Add expense") fill if(adding, soft, accent) tap set adding = not adding
  if adding
    field d
    button "Save expense" fill accent tap save d then set adding = no

  daybars last 7 days, sum(spend.amount on it)

table entry person ref person, amount money, kind pick Gave|Got, note text?
"People owe you" sum(entry.amount where kind = Gave) - sum(entry.amount where kind = Got) big
each person as p
  let bal = sum(p.entry.amount where kind = Gave) - sum(p.entry.amount where kind = Got)
  stack card tap edit p
    row
      p.name bold grow
      if(bal >= 0, "owes you", "you owe") abs(bal) color if(bal >= 0, good, bad)
    "Last entry" last(p.entry.at) faint
form person, "Add person"
form entry, "Add entry"
list entry by day
